description: Stations Vélo en Libre Service (VLS) de La Roche-sur-Yon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. Localisation des stations Vélo en Libre Service (VLS) à La Roche-sur-Yon avec visualisation en temps réel du nombre de vélos disponibles et du nombre de places vacantes. Coverage: La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "La Roche-sur-Yon Free Service Bike Stations (VLS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Roche-sur-Yon Agglomération. Its keywords include velo, libre-service, stations, temps-reel, vls. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
